forced exits remain legal for hijack, destruction/teardown, layer switch and scene shutdown

compatibility projection never guesses an ambiguous macro edge

nextTask.goal: Make materialization/lifecycle route-aware enough to preserve one stable pool slot through lane -> connector -> lane and protect connector crossing from normal despawn, without activating route-controlled visible traffic yet.
actions: Add a pure route-agent -> materialization-token adapter using compiler route geometry and the existing pointAlongPolyline sampler; do not install it as the normal traffic token source.
Extend materialization slot metadata so route stage/lane/connector/hop/progress can be copied and cleared without changing tokenId or slot identity.

Make lifecycle classification prefer explicit route stage: connector means CROSSING_JUNCTION; a lane near its end may be APPROACH_JUNCTION; retain legacy phase/edgeChanged fallback for current traffic.
Prove normal release is rejected while an active route token is crossing and the stable token still exists.
Prove forced release remains allowed for hijack/layer-switch/teardown semantics.
Prove sequential lane -> connector -> outgoing-lane tokens with the same tokenId retain the same assignment/pool slot in an integration harness.
Keep current authored-local-lanes traffic source and visible movement unchanged until M6.
acceptance: same tokenId maps to the same materialization slot across route stages
route connector stage maps to CROSSING_JUNCTION and is lifecycle-protected
normal despawn/pool release cannot evict a live crossing route token
forced lifecycle exits still release correctly
route metadata is cleared on release and cannot leak into a reused slot
legacy current traffic behavior remains unchanged when route metadata is absent
normal visible traffic is still not route-controlled
doNotAdvanceIf: retention requires increasing camera/despawn margins instead of stable identity
the same route token is rematerialized into a different slot during a crossing test
route-controlled movement is enabled globally before M6
